mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_principal_rotation_receipts (tenant_id, request_id, actor_ref, principal_id) VALUES (#{tenant}, CAST(#{request} AS uuid), #{actor}, #{principal}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, request_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT actor_ref, principal_id FROM nw_principal_rotation_receipts WHERE tenant_id = #{tenant} AND request_id = CAST(#{request} AS uuid)
